source_fingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted path + NUL + file SHA-256 hex + newline
source_fingerprint.scope: all tracked and unignored Rust/Python files, Cargo manifests/lock and rust-toolchain.toml

commands: nix develop --command cargo llvm-cov --no-clean --html -p server-bin -p server-domain -p server-ports -p server-protocol -p server-storage -p server-workspace -- --test-threads=1
scope_notes: Initial workspace coverage run stopped at server-bin checkout process test. Its corrected fixture and every remaining workspace package were rerun with --no-clean, retaining earlier profiles. Final report includes all workspace packages.
Default cargo-llvm-cov source filtering; no additional manual source exclusions; test/build/dependency source files are absent from the exported file list.
Doctests were not instrumented. Darwin aarch64 only; other Nix platforms evaluated but not executed.
Five pre-existing ignored tests require external credentials, paid requests or a separately built worker.
Owned worker process groups terminate with SIGKILL in cleanup_worker_group; successful worker IPC tests cannot be treated as measured worker line coverage because counters do not flush on that path.

deepseek_live_default_catalog ... ignored, requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and DEEPSEEK_MODEL; makes one paid API request
wf11_real_deepseek_python_hello_world ... ignored, uses API credits, credentials, and Python; run ./test_with_deepseek.sh
wf10_create_project_with_real_codex_and_commit ... ignored, requires real Codex credentials/model access and a built ait-daemon; see WF-10
